<function name="KeyPressed" parent="Player" type="classfunc">
	<description>Gets whether a key was just pressed this tick.</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="key" type="number">Corresponds to an <page>Enums/IN</page>. You can use <page>bit.bor</page> here (see example 2)</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="boolean">Was pressed or not</ret>
	</rets>
</function>

<example>
	<description>Prints whenever the first player first starts pressing <key>+FORWARD</key> key (<key>W</key> on QWERTY keyboards).</description>
	<code>
hook.Add( "Tick", "CheckPlayer1Forward", function()
	if Entity( 1 ):KeyPressed( IN_FORWARD ) then
		print( "Player1 just started moving forward!" )
	end
end )
	</code>
</example>

<example>
	<description>Respawn the player when pressing <key>+ATTACK</key>, <key>+ATTACK2</key> or <key>+JUMP</key> (defaults to <key>LMB</key>, <key>RMB</key> and <key>SPACE</key> respectively)</description>
	<code>
local respawnKeys = bit.bor( IN_ATTACK, IN_ATTACK2, IN_JUMP )
hook.Add( "PlayerDeathThink", "DoRespawn", function( ply )
	if ply:KeyPressed( respawnKeys ) then
		ply:Spawn()
	end
end )
	</code>
</example>
